facts.fact: Algeria's finance minister told the National People's Assembly on 12 December 2024 that digitising the land file, archives and documents in the land conservation offices has given automated, secured management of all land transactions.

note: The single window ordered in each office coordinates services; the source does not say it joins systems.

facts.fact: The Domaine national director general says the directorate runs a programme for complete digitisation of State domain, cadastre and land conservation services, with new services to be added to the Fada El Djazair portal.

The Direction generale du Domaine national announced the generalisation of the Amlak information system to all cadastre, land conservation and State Domains directorates, ahead of issuing the digital land booklet (Eco Times, 25 February 2026).

Algérie Zoom reports the Direction Générale du Domaine National generalised the Amlak information system to all its cadastre, land conservation and state property offices on 11 January 2026, giving immediate answers to counter requests.
Algérie Zoom reports Amlak is a unified national system joining cadastre, land conservation and state property functions on one central national database.
